SPECIAL ABILITIES

Aligned Strike (Su)

A deity’s natural weapons, as well as any weapons it wields, are treated as being aligned to both sides of the deity’s alignment and as being epic for the purpose of resolving damage reduction.

Domain Mastery (Sp)

The deity possesses at least two domains (as per the cleric class feature) of the GM’s choice. He may use any domain powers and cast any spells associated with his domains at-will. The deity counts as a 30th level cleric for the purposes of domain powers and caster level. The DCs of these spells are Wisdom based.

God of Arms (Ex)

At the start of each round, the deity may choose to use this ability. The deity’s attacks with melee and ranged weapons do not deal damage normally. Instead, each time the deity breaks a creature’s AC with such an attack, the deity may choose to either have the creature make a DC 44 Fortitude save against L-damage or may instead simply have the attack deal maximum damage.

Semi-Unlimited Wish (Sp)

The deity may cast unlimited wish once per day as a spell-like ability that does not require material components. The unlimited wish may only be in regards to something within the deity’s purview. A god of oceans could cause global draught or flooding, for instance, but could not produce any effect unrelated to oceans.

Warrior of the Gods (Ex)

The deity is a warrior among gods. He’s crossed steel with beings who rule the planes and slain the creatures upon whose bones the world was built. Damage rolls made by the deity ignore an amount of damage reduction equal to the deity’s divinity score. The deity also never takes more than 50 points of damage from any single effect that targets AC or allows a Fortitude or Reflex save

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure triple standard, whatever weapons the deity wields, +10 celestial chainmail
